implementation_iterations.observed: Native TypeScript child entries could not resolve compiled-style .js imports; web signal assertion did not match Vite's conventional status.
implementation_iterations.resolution: API and worker now build before executing dist entry points; the web process has an explicit wrapper and signal-specific assertions.

implementation_iterations.observed: An occupied-port Vite startup retained watcher handles, and SIGTERM returned Vite's conventional 143 status.
implementation_iterations.resolution: Failed web startup now closes the Vite server; SIGINT wrapper and Vite-native SIGTERM are both tested explicitly.

implementation_iterations.observed: All six outer-pnpm-only SIGINT/SIGTERM cases left re-parented descendants serving and prevented port rebind.
implementation_iterations.resolution: All public runtime scripts now use one per-app parent-aware launcher and all six post-fix attacks pass.

implementation_iterations.observed: The first candidate had a pre-PPID-sample parent-loss race, retained its watch interval after compiler failure, and mapped unexpected signals to 143.
implementation_iterations.resolution: Parent identity is checked before child launch, failed builds clear the interval and propagate exit status, conventional signal exit codes are preserved, and regression cases cover all three paths.
